notes: New-game scenarios. folk[].stage = life stage; folk[].rel = relation to the FIRST member (none|partner|spouse|child|parent|sibling). funds = coins at Normal difficulty. goals[].check: {event,count,on_time?,events?} counts game events; {cond:[...]} = SysCond for any resident; {jobs:n} = n employed residents. reward {coins, points}.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.desc: More starting coins, bills 20% cheaper, needs fall 20% slower. Good for learning.

normal.label: Normal
normal.desc: The intended balance of coins, bills and needs.

hard.label: Hard
hard.desc: 30% fewer starting coins, bills 30% dearer, needs fall 20% faster.

scenarios.label: Solo Start
scenarios.blurb: One Folk in a cosy flat. Find work, make a friend, pay your bills.
scenarios.moved_in: You've just moved in! Click %s to get started.

tips_no_computer.1: Your first goals are in 'Getting Started' at the top-left. Step one is a job: click Town at the top and open the Jobs tab, or buy a computer first.

tips: This is you. Click your Folk (the face at the bottom-left) to see their needs and mood, then click things in the world to choose what they do.
Your first goals are in 'Getting Started' at the top-left. Step one is a job: click the computer and choose Look for Jobs.
Space pauses. Keys 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. Folk look after themselves, but they do better when you steer them.
Press B to redecorate, M to visit the neighbourhood (meeting people is goal two), F1 for all controls.

goals.label: Get a job
goals.hint: Click the computer, choose Look for Jobs, then Accept the offer.
goals.hint_no_computer: No computer yet: click Town at the top, open the Jobs tab and apply there. Or press B and buy a computer.

goals.label: Make a friend
goals.hint: Open the Map (M), visit the park or cafe and chat with someone, or invite a neighbour over.

goals.label: Earn your first promotion
goals.hint: Go to work every day and keep performance up. Skills help too.

goals.label: Pay a bill on time
goals.hint: Bills arrive weekly. Keep enough coins in the household (the Coins button shows what is owed).

scenarios.label: Couple
scenarios.blurb: Two partners move in together. Make a home and see where it goes.
scenarios.moved_in: You've just moved in together! Click %s to get started.
tips: These two are a couple. Click either Folk (bottom-left) to see how they feel, then click things in the world to choose what they do.
'Getting Started' at the top-left lists ideas for settling in: furnish, find work, go on a date.
Space pauses. Keys 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. Press B to buy furniture, M to visit the neighbourhood.
Click your partner and choose Chat or Flirt to grow the relationship. Engaged couples can marry and try for a baby.

goals.label: Make it yours: buy 2 things
goals.hint: Press B for Build/Buy and add furniture or decor.

goals.label: Both find work
goals.hint: At a computer choose Look for Jobs, once for each of you.
goals.hint_no_computer: No computer yet: click Town at the top, open the Jobs tab and apply there for each of you. Or press B and buy a computer.

goals.label: Go on a date
goals.hint: Click your partner and choose a date, or visit the cafe or park together.

goals.label: Get engaged, married or expecting
goals.hint: Grow your romance, then Propose or Try for Baby.

scenarios.label: Young Family
scenarios.blurb: Two parents and a child on a tight budget. Fed, schooled, bills paid.
scenarios.moved_in: Welcome to your new family home! Click %s to get started.
tips: This is a family. Click a Folk (bottom-left) to see their needs. Children need more looking after, and go to school on school days.
'Getting Started' at the top-left has the first family goals: money, school and a full fridge.
Space pauses. Keys 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. Press B to buy furniture, M to open the map.
A parent needs a job soon: bills arrive weekly and money is tight.

goals.label: A parent finds work
goals.hint: At the computer choose Look for Jobs and Accept the offer.
goals.hint_no_computer: No computer yet: click Town at the top, open the Jobs tab and apply there. Or press B and buy a computer.

goals.label: Stock the fridge
goals.hint: Click the fridge and choose Order Groceries.
goals.label_no_fridge: Buy a fridge and stock it
goals.hint_no_fridge: Press B, buy a fridge, then click it and choose Order Groceries.

goals.label: Child goes to school
goals.hint: On weekdays the child heads to school by themselves. Make sure they are rested and fed.

goals.label: Pay a bill on time
goals.hint: Bills arrive weekly. The Coins button shows what is owed.

scenarios.label: Roommates
scenarios.blurb: Three unrelated Folk in a big house. Friendships, clashes, chores.
scenarios.moved_in: Three housemates, one big house. Click %s to get started.
tips: Three housemates. Click a Folk (bottom-left) to see their needs and mood. They will chat, clash and share chores on their own.
'Getting Started' at the top-left has ideas for the household: talk, make friends, host a get-together.
Space pauses. Keys 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. Press B to build, M to open the map, F1 for all controls.
Different traits get along differently. Watch the relationship bars when you click a housemate.

goals.label: Get chatting: 5 conversations
goals.hint: Click a housemate and choose Chat, or let them talk on their own.

goals.label: Become friends
goals.hint: Keep chatting, joking and spending time together.

goals.label: Host a get-together
goals.hint: Click a housemate and choose a group activity to invite the others.

goals.label: Pay a bill on time
goals.hint: Bills arrive weekly. The Coins button shows what is owed.

scenarios.label: Free Play
scenarios.blurb: Design a household of 1 to 6 Folk, any age, any home. No checklist.
scenarios.moved_in: Welcome home! Click %s to get started.
tips: Click one of your Folk (the faces at the bottom-left) to see their needs and mood. Click a thing in the world to choose what they do with it.
Chosen tasks queue up along the bottom-left. Right-click the ground to send a Folk somewhere.
Space pauses the game. Keys 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. Press B to build and buy, M for the map, F1 for all controls.
The Goals button shows each Folk's life aspiration. There is no checklist in Free Play: do what you like.
